padding: 270px 0 0 !important;

background: url('http://i.imgur.com/aExa6nM.jpg') top center no-repeat;

margin-top: -5px;

}

.dark div.side div.spacer:nth-of-type(1) {

padding: 270px 0 0 !important;

background: url('http://i.imgur.com/aExa6nM.jpg') top center no-repeat;

margin-top: -5px;

}

I checked 4 browsers on Android and 2 on Linux and I'm not seeing this behavior at all. I suspect it's due to the fact you're logged in as a moderator of the sub, so focus on the moderator/admin theme (or ignore it because it doesn't affect regular users).
